facts.text: Boy George showing up as himself
facts.why: Boy George does not appear. The character is an impersonation of him by Alexis Arquette (Boy George himself has commented on seeing it). Billy Idol is the one who appears as himself.
facts.fix: A Boy George lookalike at the hotel

facts.text: Serve the mains when Grandma Rosie hands Robbie her meatballs.
facts.why: In the transcript Rosie pays Robbie for his singing lessons in meatballs and has him hold out his hands and take a bite; she is his elderly neighbour, so Grandma is only a nickname.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Grandma Rosie hands Robbie her meatballs. Also on the list: Robbie getting left at the altar by Linda.
facts.why: The meatball scene is in the transcript, and the plot has Robbie left at the altar by Linda.

facts.text: Somebody kill me, please. Or pour another.
facts.why: The line is lifted from the lyrics of Robbie's song Somebody Kill Me, and lyrics are not allowed on the menu; the second half is not in the film.
facts.fix: Robbie drank heavily that night. Pour another.

facts.text: I play every wedding in Jersey and never get to eat the cake. Tonight the waitress saved me a slice.
facts.why: A note in Robbie's voice, not a quote. He is a wedding singer in New Jersey and Julia is the waitress he befriends. Keep it without quote marks.

facts.text: Julia Gulia? Say it out loud. Then dip.
facts.why: Julia's fiance is Glenn Gulia, and she tries the name 'Julia Gulia' in the mirror in the film.

vibe.verdict: A fun wedding invitation with the right set, but the eighties energy is thin and the cue and one wink are off.
missing: Grandma Rosie rapping 'Rapper's Delight' (the wedding reception)
'Grow Old with You' sung over the plane intercom (the flight)
Robbie's angry song to Linda (the empty reception)
Billy Idol in first class (the plane)
Julia Gulia in the mirror (her bedroom)
ideas: Swap 'Cob loaf spinach dip' note for the 'Julia Gulia' mirror line
Rename 'Reception pineapple sherbet punch' to 'Grow old with you punch'
Replace the Boy George wink with Billy Idol's first class seat
Add a Rapper's Delight rap line to the place card
